newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ICG Communications begun.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ICG Communications begun.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said on Friday it started coverage on the shares of IGC Communications with a buy rating and a year-end price target of $32 a share.
-- Analyst Bruce Roberts said the company was developing a low-cost competitive local exchange carrier, which would serve the company well when local industry grew more competitive.
-- ICG had the industry's most extensive set of alliances, with seven electric or water utility companies, designed to lower network construction costs by speeding time to market.
